ExcelJS 4.4.0
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/exceljs/v/4.4.0
License: MIT

These libraries are stored in this repository so Excel processing can run in the browser without loading code from a third-party CDN. Uploaded spreadsheets are not sent to these projects or services.
